features.mutationsGate: no native writes: every change is the page's own handler run as a tap would run it, with the write watched and reported; set semantics (a toggle to the state already shown answers changed:false and writes nothing); a request id is answered from an in-memory receipt (the last 64 of the page's life), so a request delivered twice runs once and the same id with another command or payload is refused; the screen gives each tap a new UUID and never resends one; no durable receipt across a reload or process death (A14/A15 gap)
features.rollout: opt-in under Settings, Appearance: Native Settings (beta), off by default; nothing opens until an APK has the plugin

features.purpose: shared top/bottom bars and make-before-break hand-over between native tabs (A23, ADR 0002)

features.source: app/shell/swipe/ (TabSwipe drives the pure SwipeModel; TabScreenView reads the gesture; SwipeVeil, SwipeHaptics)
features.owner: native draws the motion, the page decides (50-native-swipe.js)
features.purpose: swipe from one native tab to the next with a catch half way (phase 1: native to native, walls at web tabs, the Overview, Money and the ends of the bar); a swipe moves pixels, never ownership
features.decision: CONTRACT A34 and A23 item 11, ADR 0011
features.scene: while the switch is on, every navScene (NativeTabKit) and chromeScene (Food) carries swipe {v: 1, on, motion, haptics: off | light | normal | strong | max, view, active (the bar key of view, or ""), tabs [{key, view, label, icon, kind: native | web | stop, source?}] in bar order, colors {bg, text, muted} as opaque ARGB numbers (NativeTabKit.color), tune: null or the owner's changed keys}; only a scene ChromeHost draws reaches the swipe, so it keeps the bars' sequence and stale rule. Switched off, the scenes carry none and native does nothing of the swipe. fixtures/swipe-state.json is the page's own (tools/gen_native_fixtures.js), read by SwipeStateTest

plugins.ComposeTabPlugin (NativeCharacter, Nativ: handshake capability shell.swipe.v1; event swipe {token, from, to, dir, sequence, via: drag | fling}, sent once on a release that commits; method swipeSettle {token, outcome: native | refused, reason?}, answered by the page before it navigates; any other outcome reads as refused, so a later one (phase 2's web) needs shell.swipe.v2
plugins.NativeNutrition: capabilities() answers swipe: 1; the swipe event adds the screen session, and a swipeSettle naming another session is ignored

refusals.off: the swipe is not on: the switch or Swipe to switch tabs off, onboarding not done, the thumbnail pass running, or a view a swipe never starts from (Life Director)
refusals.overlay: a popup or sheet over the page (lmaTopOverlay), a body that must not scroll, or a lock cover
refusals.stale: not from the open screen of the view the page is on (a Food screen session that has ended included), or to is not the tab next to it, dir ±1, on the bar as it is now
refusals.kind: the tab is not one a native screen would open on now (phase 1 goes from one native screen to another only)
refusals.error: the decision threw; nothing else is done

features.tune: defaults in SwipeTune.kt, mirrored by LMA_TABSWIPE and held equal by SwipeTuneTest (fixtures/swipe-tune.json, written from the page); the owner's changes (Developer mode, Swipe feel (testing); lmaLoad().swipeTune) ride swipe.tune and native clamps each key: knee 0.05–0.35, breakAt knee + 0.10–0.70, heavy 0.05–1, hyst 0–0.15, popDamping 0.4–1, popStiffness 400–3000, wallMax 0–0.15, wallSlope 0–0.6, flingDp 500–3000, flingMin 0.05–0.35, backFlingDp 200–2000, commitK and cancelK 300–4000, slopFactor 1–2 (never under the platform's slop, where a child scroller claims), lockRatio 1–3, edgeDp 16–48, haptic threshold | tick | click | off
features.sourceRule: NativeLifeDirector is never a source (swipeSource = false; its section swipe and dial handles are its own); it can be a destination
features.rollout: Settings, Navigation: Native tab swipe (beta), off by default
